price.quote: Previously listed at $1499, now marked down to $1399!
price.basis: 'Previously listed at' price is the regular price; $1,933 crossed-out and $1,399 sale price not used

cls.quote: Five levels of pedal-assist and a throttle delivers the speed and power to own the road as a Class 1, 2, or 3 eBike.** ⟶ Thumb Throttle
cls.basis: maker says Class 1, 2, or 3 (selectable) with a throttle; ships as Class 2 (20 mph) per the maker FAQ; the listed 28 mph top speed is the unlocked Class 3 setting

cls.quote: All Lectric eBikes ship as a class 2 electric bike, meaning it has a throttle capable of propelling the bike at speeds of up to 20mph. Pedal assist will also be limited to 12 or 20mph in this setting depending on the model.
cls.basis: maker FAQ 'What is the classification of Lectric eBikes?'; the same answer says the XP, XPedition, XPeak, XPress, and XPress Lite can be unlocked to class 3 (28 mph)
lists Class 3 (the unlocked setting); doesn't say which class it ships in

tq.quote: A 750W rear hub-motor (1310W Peak) with 85Nm of torque delivers power and speed quicker than ever before. New Stealth M24 technology is 400% quieter*, delivering a hushed motor experience without sacrificing power. ⟶ Semi-Integrated Battery

wh.quote: A removable 48V, 15Ah (720Wh) lithium-ion battery certified to UL 2271, integrated on the down tube of the frame with a color-matched plate, makes for a clean and easily-accessible design.† The XPeak is also certified to UL 2849. ⟶ Fat Tires

range.quote: Estimated Range (from Lectric): ⟶ Up to 60 miles
range.basis: maker estimate; reviewer tested 44 mi (PAS 5) and 62 mi (PAS 1)

wt.quote: With the battery removed, the XPeak 2.0 is just 64.5 lbs. The battery weighs 10.5 lbs. ⟶ Green Packaging
TOTAL WEIGHT: ⟶ Advertised Weight: 64.5 lbs lbs | BATTERY WEIGHT: ⟶ 10.5 lbs (4.76 kg)
wt.basis: 64.5 lb advertised (maker says this is without battery) + 10.5 lb battery

motor.quote: A 750W rear hub-motor (1310W Peak) with 85Nm of torque delivers power and speed quicker than ever before. New Stealth M24 technology is 400% quieter*, delivering a hushed motor experience without sacrificing power. ⟶ Semi-Integrated Battery

fold.quote: The XPeak frame is hydroformed to maximize strength to weight ratio. The lightweight and sturdy 6000 series aluminum is available in 2 different frame styles; a diamond High-Step and an easily mountable Step-Thru. ⟶ Color
fold.basis: non-folding diamond/step-thru frame; no folding mentioned

notes: Maker link is the XPeak 2.0 (High-Step). Maker shows $1,399 sale with $1,933 crossed out, but the same page also says 'Previously listed at $1499' (EBR MSRP $1,499) — regular price is inconsistent. Class 1/2/3 with 28 mph recorded as 3. Rider height is for the High-Step frame.
